description: The 2021 Air Quality Model Guideline describes assessments of industrial activity on surrounding ambient air and a companion spreadsheet that determines whether modelling terrain is complex under section 3.0. The descriptor identifies Maximum terrain criteria,October 2000,XLS. This is an explicit calculation aid for preparing industrial air-quality modelling. The same package contains the 2021 guideline and stakeholder response, and an interpretation clarification marked OUT OF DATE. These companion documents are not separate resources. Required inputs, formulas, software compatibility and exports are not established. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source title, description and original Alberta identifiers. The record labels the material Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, current file access and numerical contents are unverified. No linked document, workbook, archive, installer or data body was fetched. Specific simulation uses remain unstated unless described above.
